cards.title: Sea of Marmara
cards.description: Light blue water with marble-like streaks. Famous for stunning sunsets and connecting the Black Sea to the Aegean

cards.title: Aegean Sea
cards.description: Crystal-clear azure water, white volcanic cliffs (e.g., Santorini), and hidden blue caves

cards.title: Coral Sea
cards.description: Turquoise water, white sand, and dramatic limestone cliffs. A paradise for snorkeling and wreck diving

cards.title: Caribbean Sea
cards.description: Bright turquoise to deep indigo water, white coral beaches, and gentle waves. Perfect for sailing and diving

cards.title: Tyrrhenian Sea
cards.description: Deep blue water around Capri and the Amalfi Coast. Famous for the electric-blue Blue Grotto

cards.title: Andaman Sea
cards.description: Emerald water with limestone karst islands (Phang Nga Bay) and hidden lagoons. Ideal for kayaking

cards.title: Flores Sea
cards.description: Sapphire-blue, exceptionally clear water with underwater volcanoes and manta rays. A top spot for advanced divers

cards.title: Weddell Sea
cards.description: Crystal-clear deep blue water, vertical coral walls, and incredible marine biodiversity. Perfect for diving with sea turtles and pristine reefs
